$comment: OWNER-OWNED FILE. This ledger records the engine defects that committed inputs in engine/examples/defect-cases/ reproduce TODAY. It records reality; it is not permission to fail. IT MAY ONLY SHRINK. Appending an entry here to turn a red check green is prohibited — the fix is to fix the engine and delete the entry, not to declare a new defect. The defect-ledger test in engine/tests/ enforces both directions: a defect case that violates an invariant NOT listed here fails with an unknown-violation error (the defect got worse), and a ledgered invariant that a case has STOPPED violating fails with STALE DEFECT DECLARATION until the entry is deleted (so landing the fix forces the ledger down). No script writes this file, by design — a check that can rewrite its own baseline is not a check. Same direction as frontend/test-baseline.json and gate-skips.lock, which may only shrink; the exact inverse of gates.manifest.lock, which may only grow. Every 'observed' block below was measured by running the named case through engine/target/release/inheritance-engine, which calls run_pipeline_checked and exits 2. No entry here decides any point of Philippine law: each names the requirement that already owns the fix, and where that requirement is blocked on a lawyer's answer it cites the recorded decision id without stating which reading is correct.
